lead.headline: Robinhood Mainnet Launch Signals Shift Toward Integrated Retail L2s
lead.tldr: The launch of Robinhood Chain marks a transition from simple asset brokerage to full-stack infrastructure ownership to capture agentic trading and 24/7 equity flows.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Inside Trump’s $1.4 billion crypto empire: altcoins, Bitcoin—and a stake in Michael Saylor’s Strategy
top_signals.summary: An analysis of Donald Trump's crypto portfolio, valued at approximately $1.4 billion, highlighting his holdings in Bitcoin and altcoins. The wealth is primarily driven by his family's venture, World Liberty Financial, and strategic ties to Michael Saylor's investment approach.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Political alignment with Bitcoin maximalism at the highest level of US governance reduces long-term regulatory tail risk for BTC holders.

top_signals.title: Robinhood Chain goes live on mainnet alongside 24/7 tokenized stocks, Lighter perps and planned crypto agentic trading
top_signals.summary: Robinhood has launched its own Layer 2 blockchain on mainnet utilizing Arbitrum's technology stack. The network debuts with 24/7 tokenized stocks, Lighter perpetuals, and a partnership with Uniswap, while planning for agentic crypto trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: By owning the L2, Robinhood eliminates third-party gas dependencies and creates a closed-loop ecosystem for tokenized equities and AI agents.

top_signals.title: Europe's MiCA crypto regime is fully in force: Here's who wins and loses
top_signals.summary: The European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation has fully entered its final transition phase as of July 1. The regime establishes a comprehensive legal framework for crypto-assets, impacting how companies and users operate within the EU market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: MiCA provides the first predictable legal playbook for institutional scaling in Europe, favoring compliant incumbents over unregulated startups.

top_signals.title: Former Goliath CEO Pleads Guilty to Crypto Fraud, Money Laundering
top_signals.summary: Former Goliath Ventures CEO Christopher Delgado has pleaded guilty to fraud and money laundering. The scheme involved taking in at least $400 million and resulting in investor losses of at least $250 million.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $250M loss at Goliath Ventures serves as a reminder that lack of custody transparency remains a primary failure point for crypto funds.

top_signals.title: Taiwan’s legislature passes crypto, stablecoin regulations42m, Taiwan’s legislature passes crypto, stablecoin regulationsTaiwan’s legislative branch has passed the nation’s first crypto and stablecoin rules, which aim to integrate the country with the global crypto market.
top_signals.summary: Taiwan's legislature has passed its first set of regulations governing cryptocurrencies and stablecoins. The move is designed to integrate Taiwan more effectively with the global digital asset market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Taiwan's regulatory clarity accelerates the integration of East Asian capital into global stablecoin liquidity pools.

deals.summary: Venice AI, founded by Erik Voorhees, has secured $65 million in Series A funding. The company has reached a $1 billion valuation as investors bet on the demand for privacy-centric artificial intelligence.

Ark Invest has acquired $18 million in shares of Circle following a significant dip in the company's stock value. The decline is attributed in part to the launch of a competing stablecoin project, OUSD.

on_the_radar.title: Open USD 출범이 써클 17% 하락을 이끈 이유
on_the_radar.summary: The announcement of Open USD (OUSD), a joint stablecoin backed by 140 companies including Visa and BlackRock, caused Circle's stock to drop 17%. OUSD introduces a 'revenue-sharing standard' for reserve interest, threatening Circle's proprietary business model and its strategic partnerships.

on_the_radar.title: Robinhood rolls out public blockchain, plans crypto trading for UK residents16m
on_the_radar.summary: Robinhood is expanding its crypto offerings by launching a public blockchain and planning to enable crypto trading for users in the UK. This move signals a strategic push to integrate deeper Web3 infrastructure and expand its global market reach.

on_the_radar.title: Tradeweb Completes Tokenized US Treasury Trade on Canton
on_the_radar.summary: Tradeweb has successfully facilitated a real-time tokenized US Treasury trade between Franklin Templeton and Virtu Financial. The transaction was executed on the Canton Network, demonstrating the viability of blockchain for institutional fixed-income markets.

on_the_radar.title: Binance Adds Anchorage Digital Off-Exchange Settlement
on_the_radar.summary: Binance and Anchorage Digital have launched an off-exchange settlement model designed for institutional traders. This integration allows institutions to trade on Binance while maintaining their assets in qualified custody.

on_the_radar.title: French banking giant Crédit Agricole launches EURXT euro stablecoin
on_the_radar.summary: Crédit Agricole's CACEIS has launched EURXT, a euro-pegged stablecoin deployed on the Ethereum blockchain. The initiative aims to facilitate institutional financial flows and provide streamlined access to tokenized funds.

on_the_radar.title: Nearly 1,700 UK investors sue Binance, founder CZ over alleged unauthorized derivatives sales
on_the_radar.summary: Nearly 1,700 UK investors have filed a lawsuit against Binance and its founder, Changpeng Zhao, in the London High Court. The legal action centers on allegations regarding the unauthorized sale of crypto derivatives to these investors.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Record $4.5B Outflows in June
on_the_radar.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced record-breaking outflows totaling $4.5 billion during the month of June. This volume significantly exceeds the sell authorization of $1.25 billion under MicroStrategy's new capital framework.

on_the_radar.title: Taiwan’s legislature passes crypto, stablecoin regulations
on_the_radar.summary: Taiwan's legislature has passed its first set of regulations governing cryptocurrencies and stablecoins. These rules are designed to integrate Taiwan more effectively with the global digital asset market.

worth_a_read.note: Essential for understanding how South Korean institutional mandates are differing from Western adoption patterns.

worth_a_read.note: Provides a concrete example of how autonomous vehicle scaleups are utilizing blockchain for operational data integrity.

linkedin_post: Robinhood launching its own L2 on Arbitrum is a calculated move to capture the entire value chain of retail trading. Most platforms are content being an interface; Robinhood is now the infrastructure. By integrating 24/7 tokenized stocks and Lighter perps directly on their own chain, they are removing the friction of external bridges and gas fees that typically kill retail conversion. What I keep coming back to is the mention of agentic trading. If Robinhood can build a network where AI agents execute trades on tokenized equities without human intervention, they move from a brokerage to a high-frequency liquidity hub. I'd watch how this affects the competitive moat of traditional L2s that rely on fragmented dApp ecosystems rather than a built-in user base of millions. The real test will be whether they can migrate their existing non-crypto users onto the chain without them realizing they are using a blockchain.
